title: Going through overnight customer complaints and deciding which ones the support team should call back
task: Going through overnight customer complaints and deciding which ones the support team should call back
trigger: the overnight complaints queue is full at the start of the day

steps.name: open the overnight complaints queue
steps.whatHappens: Open the queue of complaints that came in overnight.
steps.decidedHow: the queue is the list of what arrived while nobody was watching

steps.name: read each complaint and tag it by type
steps.whatHappens: Read the complaint and tag what kind it is.
steps.decidedHow: the type decides who answers it

steps.name: check the order and the delivery date
steps.whatHappens: Look up the order and when it was meant to arrive.
steps.decidedHow: the dates decide whether it is urgent

steps.name: decide whether the support team should call back
steps.whatHappens: Decide whether this one needs a call back today.
steps.decidedHow: the support team has only so many calls in a day

steps.name: assign it to a support agent
steps.whatHappens: Give the complaint to one of the support agents.
steps.decidedHow: each agent has their own customers

steps.name: note the complaint and the decision
steps.whatHappens: Note the complaint and what was decided.
steps.decidedHow: the note is what the agent sees

steps.name: close the complaint in the system
steps.whatHappens: Close the complaint once it is assigned.
steps.decidedHow: an open complaint stays on the queue

mistakeConsequence: a customer waits a second day for a call
currentState: by hand from a printed queue
frustration: the same complaint types come back every morning
